parts.title: The Temple
parts.text: Deep in the jungle stood an **ancient** temple, thousands of years old and covered in vines. Maya had always wanted to **explore** every hidden corner of the forest, and this was her greatest discovery yet. Carved into the stone doorway was a **peculiar** mark — a golden sun with twelve rays, unlike anything she had seen before.

parts.title: The Puzzle
parts.text: The walls inside were covered with carvings set in **flimsy** plaster, so thin it could crumble at a touch. Some of the carvings seemed to **resemble** animals, so Maya sketched them in her notebook. A sharp thorn from a vine pricked her finger, and she had to **recoil** and snatch her hand back. She found a **radiant** gemstone hidden behind a loose brick — it was so bright that it lit up her whole face.

parts.title: The Trial
parts.text: Aarav appeared and tried to **accuse** Maya of stealing the gemstone, saying she had taken it from his family's land. But Maya was **clever** enough to show him the temple map proving it belonged to no one. She hiked back along the **coast**, where the ocean waves crashed against the rocky shore. Priya, the village elder, praised Maya's **wisdom** in handling the argument peacefully. Finding the temple left Maya **elated** — happier than she had ever been.

parts.title: The Gift
parts.text: Maya donated the gemstone to the village museum, where it became the centerpiece of a new exhibit. Aarav apologized and the two became friends, often returning to the temple together to study its carvings. The village celebrated Maya's discovery with a festival, and the elder Priya said it was the most important find in the village's history.
